system.description:
Your illusions have grown so potent that you can bend a whole crowd's grasp of the real, drowning many minds at once in the same waking nightmare.

You can cause whole groups of people to experience Horrid Reality: all of your opponents see the same illusion and believe it to be real. You must win a Mental Challenge against each target in turn for the power to succeed against that target. The illusion persists until it is disbelieved or you leave the vicinity.
